svg.text: 1 Same efficiency axis, three kernels, two ways of moving along it

Grey: VALU deleted. Green/purple: the same stream re-scheduled. Orange: FlyDSL re-scheduled. Triangles: FlyDSL with its pacing removed, which is the only lever that raises its efficiency -- and it stays on the same parallel line.
2 Per GHz, the sweeps collapse; FlyDSL sits above on its shorter fill/drain
Independent fits agree to 0.5% in slope: 7.36 (deleting) vs 7.33 (re-scheduling).
3 Clock is set by efficiency alone — one line covers both kernels
Every re-scheduled point of both kernels is within 1.7% of it. Deleting VALU (grey) leaves the clock flat instead, because it removes the power as well.
one line, both kernels: -11.7 MHz per point (R²=0.92)
